# Lux in Tenebris

> A daily dark-broadsheet recap of the most disruptive AI news from the last 24 hours. Every edition is available as plain markdown — no JavaScript or scraping required.

## Markdown editions

- [Latest edition](https://luxintenebris.news/latest.md) — always the current issue
- [Edition index](https://luxintenebris.news/editions/index.md) — reverse-chronological list of every edition
- Editions live at `https://luxintenebris.news/editions/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (e.g. [2026-07-31](https://luxintenebris.news/editions/2026-07-31.md)); archive runs from 2026-07-02 onward, not necessarily every day

## Site

- [Current issue (HTML)](https://luxintenebris.news/)
- [Archive (HTML)](https://luxintenebris.news/archive/)
